credential_help.open_ai_api: Organization ADMINISTRATION key (Admin API), not a regular project key.
credential_help.anthropic_api: Administration key (sk-ant-admin01-...) for the Usage & Cost Admin API.
credential_help.chat_gpt: Use the OAuth ACCESS token (not the refresh or ID token). Codex internal interface: covers agent windows, NOT the web chat quota; subject to change without notice.
credential_help.claude: OAuth access token. Interface is not officially documented, subject to change.
credential_help.gemini_api: Google Cloud OAuth access token (e.g. `gcloud auth application-default print-access-token`).
credential_help.vertex_ai: Google Cloud OAuth access token (e.g. `gcloud auth application-default print-access-token`).
credential_help.azure_open_ai: Azure access token with cost-read permission.
credential_help.cursor: Teams/Enterprise Admin API: variable CURSOR_ADMIN_API_KEY. For personal accounts, press Tab and confirm to import the local Cursor session. Never opens OAuth or reads tokens without confirmation.
credential_help.copilot: GitHub token of the ACCOUNT, never the internal copilotToken. Billing (default): classic PAT. Personal quota (opt-in): GitHub token with access to the internal endpoint; OAuth/PAT accepted depends on the provider.
credential_help.windsurf: Requires Enterprise with Billing Read and Teams Read-Only permissions.
credential_help.mistral: Consumption query requires Admin API Key, not a generation key. Use MISTRAL_API_KEY with the admin key or set admin_key_env in the parameters.
credential_help.grok: xAI team access token (Management API or CLI). Management API default: Management Key + Team ID. CLI opt-in: Grok CLI session token. Do not confuse with the X social API key.
credential_help.perplexity: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY is kept. Sonar does not expose balance with this key; Computer Enterprise Analytics is a separate query, opt-in via parameters.
credential_help.gemini_ai: Default: Gemini/AI Studio key — this key does NOT query quota (use Gemini CLI/CodeAssist in parameters). CLI opt-in: Gemini CLI session token.
credential_help.cline: Cline API key or account token (CLINE_API_KEY). Queries Cline balance; BYOK must be tracked at the key's provider. Optional organization in parameters.
credential_help.kimi: KIMI_API_KEY (Moonshot/Kimi). Default: international account balance. Coding opt-in: accepts the platform key OR an OAuth access token (set the variable name in token_env); the key has priority.
credential_help.qoder: QODER_API_KEY accepts PAT (pt-..., exchanged for a job token) or an existing Bearer/job token (jt-.../device). Choose the credential type in parameters.
credential_help.open_code_go: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY of the account; the user's own key authenticates the internal query.
credential_help.groq: GROQ_API_KEY of the account; the user's own key authenticates the internal query.
credential_help.ollama_cloud: OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY of the account (Bearer); usage in GET ollama.com/api/usage and plan in POST /api/me. No cookie import required.
credential_help.xiaomi_mimo: Balance/Token Plan: configure platform_session_env with the platform.xiaomimimo.com web session. The native code returns an inference key, not a cookie. session_env is separate: weekly MiMo Desktop quota.
credential_help.kiro: Kiro/CodeWhisperer access token (not refresh token). Source via auth_method: builder-id (default), idc, google, github, import, api_key or external_idp.
credential_help.code_buddy: CodeBuddy session access token (cn: copilot.tencent.com; intl: www.codebuddy.ai).
credential_help.zed: ZED_ACCESS_TOKEN (cloud access token of the zed.dev native login flow). Also set the numeric user_id — it is sent as `Authorization: <user_id> <token>`.
credential_help.alibaba_model_studio: Alibaba Model Studio/DashScope API key. Can point to QWEN_API_KEY. Select the region matching your account; not a Qwen Code OAuth login.
credential_help.alibaba_coding_plan: Alibaba Coding Plan subscription key (usually sk-sp-). Select China or international; different from a standard DashScope API key.
credential_help.alibaba_token_plan: The Token Plan quota queries, by default, the dedicated `bl` profile (`params.cli_profile`, configured by F2). `params.session_env` (home.qwencloud.com cookie) is an optional override. QWEN_API_KEY authenticates only inference and is not sent to the query.
credential_help.alibaba_cloud: Set the NAME of the variable holding the AccessKey ID of the billing RAM account. In Parameters set the AccessKey Secret variable; the values are never written into TOML.
credential_help.antigravity: Antigravity Google session, distinct from the Gemini API key. Press Tab for native login; the Code Assist project and quota windows are queried automatically.
credential_help.kimchi: KIMCHI_API_KEY of the Kimchi account; queries credits and budgets at llm.kimchi.dev, no generation.

field.alibaba_coding_plan.region.help: Use the region of the subscription; the credential is not sent automatically to another region.

field.alibaba_token_plan.session_env.hel: Empty = quota via the dedicated `bl` profile (`params.cli_profile`). For the manual route, set the NAME of the variable holding the home.qwencloud.com cookie; never paste the cookie here.

query.cloudflare.unsupported: Cloudflare Workers AI does not expose a public per-key usage/quota read endpoint. Neuron accounting is only shown in the dashboard (https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/ai/workers-ai).
